info.title: Workeasy Campaign API
info.description: Browser API. Cookie session + X-CSRF-Token on state-changing requests. Errors use one shape (Error). Organization/workspace routes answer 404 to non-members and 403 to members lacking the permission.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password

Change password; signs out other sessions

get.summary: Current organization, workspace and effective permissions

post.summary: Create organization + first workspace (requires verified email)

delete.summary: Delete organization (type its name to confirm)

put.summary: Add member to workspace or change their role

post.summary: Accept (signed in as the invited, verified email)
